From Khnum · Price: only faces; voice and body stay yours.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: change your face to look like a person you've seen. +4 status to Deception to Impersonate them.
  • 5: Also change a willing ally's face.
  • 9: Surge: lasts 1 day.
  • 13: Change voice too.
  • 17: Reaction: change your face as a creature looks at you, ending a gaze or visual-recognition effect.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.yHlyQmatYtQxl45d]{Effect: Disguise}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
